item.title: The UK will help Ukraine make long-range missiles by sharing classified tech information
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham announces the U.K. will help Ukraine make its own long-range missiles

item.title: Putin issues decree opening door to state control of key sites after drone strikes
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin has signed a decree allowing the government to take temporary control of critical infrastructure if private owners fail to protect it from Ukrainian drone attacks or repair it afterward

item.title: Colombia’s armed groups recruit children and train them in drone warfare, rights group says
item.description: A new Human Rights Watch report says drug gangs and rebel groups in Colombia are increasingly recruiting children for dangerous tasks, including piloting drones carrying explosives

item.title: 2 UN peacekeepers killed in an ambush in South Sudan
item.description: Two United Nations peacekeepers have been killed in an ambush in South Sudan

item.title: Gang coalition unleashes violent new attack on farming community in Haiti
item.description: A powerful gang coalition in Haiti has attacked a once peaceful farming community nestled in the hills above the country's capital

item.title: Kazakhstan's pro-government party wins parliamentary election
item.description: Officials say Kazakhstan’s pro-government Adilet Oarty won a landslide victory in the Central Asian country’s parliamentary elections
